TNT Springs, Inc. was founded in 1986 and operates from locations in Billings and Belgrade, Montana. The company has over 40 years of experience supplying truck and trailer parts to customers across the region.

The business functions as a distributor of heavy-duty truck and trailer components, maintaining a large inventory that includes air bags, springs, air brake system components, suspension parts, wheels, and other heavy truck parts. It offers local delivery within Montana and to northwestern North Dakota and Wyoming, as well as nationwide shipping.

Its customer base consists of truck drivers, fleet operators, and repair shops throughout Montana, North Dakota, and Wyoming, with the company noting that drivers visit its stores from surrounding cities. The product range targets commercial trucking and trailer maintenance needs.

TNT Springs emphasizes its extensive inventory and local delivery capabilities as key differentiators, stating that if a part cannot be found in its stock, it likely does not exist. The company also highlights affordable pricing on premium parts.

name: TVS Manufacturing Specialist, Inc.
old_description: TVS Manufacturing Specialists, Inc. operates with two key divisions, each focusing on distinct areas of expertise. One division specializes in the design and manufacturing of high-quality magnetic components, offering innovative solutions for a range of industries. The other division is dedicated to the production of durable and efficient battery cables, ensuring optimal performance and safety for various applications. Together, these two divisions position TVS as a leader in providing specialized, reliable components for diverse markets.
about:
TVS Manufacturing Specialists, Inc. is a veteran-owned company based in Lexington, South Carolina. The firm has been in operation for 45 years, though its exact founding year is not publicly disclosed. It operates as a veteran-owned and operated business, with ownership held by military veterans.

The company runs two distinct divisions. One focuses on the design and manufacture of magnetic components, including air coils, toroids, high-voltage transformers, and springs. The other produces battery cables and wiring assemblies for applications such as golf carts, marine vessels, and material-handling equipment like forklifts. TVS handles pre-production planning, first-piece inspection and test, in-process audits, and final audit and test, emphasizing on-time delivery.

Its customer base spans the golf cart, marine, and material-handling industries, with magnetic components also serving a broader range of industrial sectors. The company supplies both standard and custom components to original equipment manufacturers and aftermarket distributors.

TVS was founded on a mission of delivering excellence with uncompromising quality, a principle reflected in its quality statement: meeting customer design specifications through effective control, employee training, and a commitment that the objective ends only when the product is in the hands of a satisfied customer. Its veteran-owned status underscores a culture of discipline and reliability.

name: TY Fine Furniture
old_description: Founded in 2004, T.Y. Fine Furniture combines old-world craftsmanship with modern precision. Our founder, Tarik Yousef, brings an engineering background from Honda to furniture design—every joint is calculated for strength, every detail considered for longevity. We use traditional mortise and tenon joinery reinforced with stainless steel dowels, not cheap metal brackets or cam locks.
about:
T.Y. Fine Furniture was founded in 2004 in Columbus, Ohio, by Tarik Yousef, a former Honda engineer who applied his precision background to furniture design. The company began with a focus on combining traditional joinery techniques with modern engineering principles.

The workshop produces solid-wood furniture for bedrooms, dining rooms, living rooms, and home offices, using four Ohio hardwoods — cherry, black walnut, white oak, and hard maple. Each piece is built to order using mortise-and-tenon, dovetail, and floating-tenon joinery reinforced with stainless steel dowels, with boards hand-selected for grain and color. Finishing is done by hand with a zero-VOC, food-grade organic oil developed in collaboration with an Ohio State microbiologist. The company operates its own shop within a 200-mile radius of Columbus and maintains two retail showrooms in the Clintonville and Grandview Heights neighborhoods.

The primary customer base is residential buyers seeking heirloom-quality furniture, though the showrooms also carry complementary lines from Stressless, American Leather, Fjords, and Naturepedic. Design professionals and individual clients commission custom dimensions and configurations.

The company differentiates itself through a lifetime structural guarantee, a finish safe enough for nursery use, and a program that plants two trees for every order placed.

name: Tabb Textile Systems Inc
old_description: For over 45 years, Tabb Textile Company Inc. has been a leading converter, importer, and USA manufacturer of fabrics and finished goods within the textile industry. Tabb Textile Company Inc. is headquartered and operates in its 250,000 square foot warehouse in Opelika, Alabama.
about:
Tabb Textile Company Inc. was founded in 1972 in Opelika, Alabama, as a family-owned and operated business. The company began as a converter, importer, and domestic manufacturer of fabrics and finished textile goods, and today it is led by CEO Zach Fenster.

The firm converts, imports, and manufactures a range of textiles including linens, woven and knit fabrics, apparel, and finished goods. It operates a 250,000-square-foot flagship fulfillment center in Opelika, supplemented by multiple distribution centers spanning the East and West coasts. Capabilities include custom specifications, Kaumagraphing for logos, Pantone color matching, private labeling, custom printing, and cut-and-sew services. Quality control involves on-site inspections and ASTM lab testing upon request.

Tabb Textile serves both B2B and B2G markets, with a focus on government agencies (including the Department of Defense, Defense Logistics Agency, Department of Health and Human Services, Department of Education, Department of Transportation, and Department of Veterans Affairs), healthcare facilities, hospitality businesses, commercial laundries, correctional institutions, and apparel manufacturers. The company holds a GSA Schedule contract and has multiple award agreements with federal, state, and local entities.

The company emphasizes supply-chain consistency through trained staff, modern manufacturing technology, long-term supplier relationships, and a comprehensive quality system. It differentiates itself with a large-stock inventory program, quick lead times from coast-to-coast warehouses, and a customer-service approach described as trustworthy and approachable.

about:
Taylor Packaging Corporation has operated from Imperial, Missouri since 1980. The company was founded as a family-owned business and continues as a female-owned and operated enterprise. Its Midwest location is intended to reduce shipping lead times and costs for customers across the region.

The company manufactures custom thermoformed plastic packaging, offering a full range of services from design and prototyping through tooling, production, assembly, and fulfillment. It runs a stock tooling program that includes more than 300 standard cavities and blisters and over 100 clamshell sizes, which can eliminate or reduce tooling expenses and accelerate time to market. Materials processed include clear, recycled, virgin, and color-matched plastics.

Taylor Packaging serves retail and shipping sectors, along with various other industries that require custom plastic packaging for product visibility and protection. Its VersaCLAM™ line provides ready-to-use clamshell and blister solutions, while custom development supports unique product presentations.

The company emphasizes sustainable practices, reporting a 95% recycling rate for production scrap and powering its facility with LED lighting and solar panels. Its female leadership has been recognized by the St. Louis Business Journal as a Top Women Business Owner for multiple years, and the operation was featured on the ION Television Network’s “World’s Greatest” series.

name: Team Solar Inc
old_description: Team Solar was founded in 2016 by two brothers. Jonathan and James Neal are both industry experts motivated by helping members of the community. Team Solar has a remarkable and lean staff. Every Member of our organization has a passion for renewable and energy efficient technology. We strive for success through our educational focus that is unique to our brand. The sole purpose of Team Solar is to educate and advise our clients.
about:
Team Solar Inc was founded in 2016 by brothers Jonathan and James Neal in Portland, Maine, with a second office in Framingham, Massachusetts. The two industry experts started the company to educate and advise property owners on renewable energy options, positioning themselves as consultants rather than traditional sales-driven installers.

The firm provides end‑to‑end solar services for commercial, residential, and non‑profit clients. Its process moves from an initial consultation through engineering and construction to a monthly payment structure, and the company reports having delivered roughly 1,900 kilowatts of installed capacity across 141 customers. A lean staff handles design, permitting, and project management for each installation.

Commercial property owners, homeowners, and a range of non‑profit organizations make up the customer base. The non‑profit program, which installs systems at no upfront cost and shares utility revenue with the host, has served VFW posts, American Legion halls, religious buildings, Boys & Girls Clubs, YMCAs, municipalities, and low‑income housing developments in Maine and Massachusetts.

The founders say the business was built on an educational focus that avoids aggressive sales tactics, customizing every proposal to the client’s financial situation and energy goals. That approach, they claim, helps customers achieve energy independence while stabilizing long‑term operating costs.

name: Tekmos
old_description: We provide companies the best solutions for bridging the gap between standard parts and a completed finished product with the least risk and the lowest development cost. We select the most cost effective process technology and combine devices into a highly integrated low cost device with fast time to market.
about:
Tekmos, Inc. is a fabless semiconductor company headquartered in Austin, Texas. Founded in 1997 as a spin-off of Flextronics Semiconductor, the company began as a contract design center handling FPGA conversions and large FPGA-based systems for on-demand cable providers.

Today Tekmos designs and manufactures custom analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits, including ASICs, FPGAs, microprocessors, flash memories, and high-temperature chips. The company leverages SOI CMOS processes for operation up to 300°C and bulk silicon up to 200°C, and offers stacked die packaging that combines up to nine different chips in a single package. With over 900 completed designs, Tekmos serves hundreds of customers worldwide, delivering volumes from prototype to over 100,000 units annually for individual part numbers.

The company serves consumer electronics, aerospace, automotive, defense, industrial, medical, oil and gas, and telecommunications markets. Concrete examples include supplying replacement processors for grounded military aircraft, high-temperature ASICs for downhole drilling steering, chips for fitness wearables and oral medical devices, and 60,000 emergency units to restore telephone service in New Orleans after Hurricane Katrina. Tekmos also recreated obsolete telecom ASICs for Lucent switches after Agere end-of-lifed the original parts.

Tekmos positions itself as a bridge between standard components and finished products, emphasizing low development risk, low cost, and fast time to market. Its differentiators include full military lot qualification (MIL-STD-883 and MIL-PRF-38535 flows), ITAR registration, AS9100D certification, and the ability to reverse-engineer legacy parts into modern, manufacturable designs.

old_description: Telan Corporation is a US based contract electronics manufacturer focusing on PCB Manufacturing and Assembly. Our capabilities include fast turnaround times on your quotes and delivery of PCB assemblies. We can handle any size run so be sure to contact us. We have over 40 years of experience and are dedicated to your total satisfaction. Allow the Telan team to become your SMT Contract Electronics Manufacturer of choice. about:
Telan Corporation operates from an 18,000-square-foot facility in Hatfield, Pennsylvania. The company was founded in 2003 and is led by President and CEO Conrad J. Nelson, with Shawn Goodwin as Director of Operations & Purchasing and George Kohn as Plant Manager & Quality Assurance.

Telan specializes in contract electronics manufacturing, providing printed circuit board assembly services that span surface-mount, through-hole, and mixed-technology processes. The facility supports both lead-free and leaded soldering using reflow ovens, wave soldering, and fully automated selective soldering equipment, along with hand soldering for delicate requirements. Additional capabilities include conformal coating, automated optical inspection (Mirtec MV-3), functional testing, box-build assembly, and PCB sourcing for consignment or turnkey programs. The shop handles high-volume, low-mix production as well as small-quantity runs.

The company serves original equipment manufacturers in sectors such as hospitality security and monitoring systems, as evidenced by long-term client testimonials. Customers range from those needing quick-turn prototypes to those requiring sustained high-volume delivery.

Telan emphasizes IPC-A-610 workmanship standards, competitive pricing, and on-time delivery as its core differentiators. The firm promotes fast quote turnaround (24–48 hours), typical production lead times of three to four weeks, and a commitment to long-term customer relationships built on consistent quality and responsive service.

name: Tennessee Chair Company
old_description: Tennessee Chair Company, which began in 1979, specializes in quality hardwood furniture. Our reputation throughout the southeast has been built around the comfort of our hand-made rocking chairs. We offer rockers in many different styles for not only adults but for children as well. While most of our chairs are constructed from white ash, one can choose to have their chair built from black walnut, red oak, wild cherry, poplar, or wormy maple.
about:
Tennessee Chair Company was founded in 1979 in Readyville, Tennessee, by Tim and Beth Watts. Tim began selling hardwood porch furniture at events and fairs across the Southeast in 1977, and after over 30 years on the road, the company's primary account became the Tennessee Farmer's Cooperative.

The company manufactures handmade hardwood furniture, specializing in rocking chairs for adults and children, as well as dining sets, hutches, and barstools. Its reputation throughout the Southeast has been built around the comfort of its hand-made rocking chairs. Most pieces are built from white ash, with options for black walnut, red oak, wild cherry, poplar, and wormy maple. The Readyville location provides access to native hardwoods ideal for furniture construction.

The company serves residential customers and retail partners across the Southeast, with the Tennessee Farmer's Cooperative as its main account. Products are sold through events, fairs, and direct sales.

The company emphasizes comfort, quality, and lumbar support, attributing success to craftsmanship and customer relationships. They offer personalization options for each piece, and the founders credit their success to their faith and the free enterprise system.

old_description: Tennessee Sheet Metal, Inc., is a company that believes in providing the greatest possible quality and service to its customers. Founded in 1951, on that principle, we have grown to become one of the largest sheet metal shops in the mid-state area, while retaining personalized service to our customers.
about:
Tennessee Sheet Metal, Inc. was founded in 1951 in Madison, Tennessee, a community just north of Nashville. The company began with a principle of providing the greatest possible quality and service to its customers, a philosophy that has guided its growth over seven decades.

Today the firm operates from a 45,000-square-foot facility where a team of sheet metal engineers and skilled craftsmen engineer, design, fabricate, and erect a range of products. Core offerings include stainless steel kitchen equipment, industrial and commercial sheet metal work, and complete air-conditioning, heating, and ventilating systems. Specific services cover air duct systems, dust collection systems, stainless steel fabrication and welding, custom applications, and exhaust systems. The shop runs equipment such as a plasma table, a Trimble Autobid system, a 10-ton crane, a Spiro pipe machine, and a duct coil line.

The company serves commercial construction, industrial manufacturing, HVAC, and food-service equipment sectors. Its customer base includes contractors and facility owners needing custom ductwork, kitchen exhaust hoods, dust collection networks, and specialized stainless steel assemblies for industrial plants.

Tennessee Sheet Metal emphasizes that its founding commitment to quality and personalized service remains intact despite becoming one of the largest sheet metal shops in the mid-state region.
